breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The user prompt contained a contradictory instruction to use a gamma-centered k-point grid and a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh. The ground truth resolves this by removing the request for a half shift. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead repeated the contradictory instruction: 'Use a gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift.'
